recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not recreate the old online statusReason code or edit DeviceComponent for this issue; any future Device operation or association status reason modeling should be handled under a separate Jira decision.
issue_request: FHIR-26897 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It reported that the Device statusReason value set expansion showed an online entry whose definition said "The device is off.", with an approved resolution to use "The device is connected to a network or system." Later comments clarified that the original definitions were not helpful and that the statusReason codes were actually discarded/obsolete/removed while online was only a stale label.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-26897-tagged source commit was found. Commit 798a3197ab728359e8d056551c908ae12ec9a04e, authored by the assignee shortly after the vote, changed source/device/device-spreadsheet.xml by removing the old online/paused/standby/offline/not-ready-style statusReason rows and replacing them with discarded, obsolete, and removed definitions, thereby removing the erroneous online/off pairing from authoritative source.
additional_context: Commit 50f4a45ebb2bb55a1ebcdc1a491aebc2b0c1f8b1 later deleted source/device/codesystem-device-status-reason.xml and source/device/valueset-device-status-reason.xml while introducing the newer Device operation status-reason terminology. The combined branch already contains a separate FHIR-36213 audit/fix for that later terminology family. Current XML parsing finds no active Device.statusReason or Device.operation.statusReason element; the remaining "The device is off." hit is DeviceComponent operational-status code off, and DeviceComponent is dropped/commented out in fhir.ini.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current build no longer contains the FHIR-26897 target artifact or erroneous online definition, and editing the out-of-build DeviceComponent artifact would not address this Device issue.
